context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 focused on NEW ephemeral media messaging feature. All features working correctly. Backend: All 14 tests passed - upload with view_limit=1/2, auto-send message, invalid mime_type rejected, token generation with 60s expiry, view count tracking, view-once blocks 2nd view, view-twice allows 2 views blocks 3rd, status endpoint, uploader can always view, security checks (wrong media_id rejected, expired token rejected). Frontend: Media options menu visible with Photo/View Once/View Twice buttons, ephemeral messages render with flame/eye icons, expired media shows placeholder, media viewer modal works. Core features from iterations 1-5 (auth, chat, nearby, proximity, presence, anonymous) still working. No issues found.
